componentPlan.name: DashboardHeader
componentPlan.responsibility: Thin wrapper around the existing <AppHeader/> that keeps the time-of-day greeting kicker, firstName title and avatar exactly, but owns the surrounding spacing/typography polish so the screen no longer inlines the header. Does not modify AppHeader internals.
componentPlan.props: interface DashboardHeaderProps { greeting: string; firstName: string }  // greeting = greetingForNow(); firstName = user?.name?.split(' ')[0] ?? 'there'. Renders <AppHeader kicker={greeting} title={firstName} align="left" />
animations: none of its own; caller wraps it in <Reveal index={0}/> for the staggered entrance

componentPlan.name: CategoryTabs
componentPlan.responsibility: API-driven horizontal category chips from meta.tabs (DashboardTab[]). Controlled component; parent owns activeTab/onChange. Replaces inline renderChips() and is reused for both the in-flow header chips and the floating auto-hiding bar. Each chip is a PressableScale (activeScale 0.93).
componentPlan.props: import type { DashboardTab } from '@/api/types'; interface CategoryTabsProps { tabs: DashboardTab[]; activeKey: string; onChange: (key: string) => void; style?: StyleProp<ViewStyle> }
animations: PressableScale spring press feedback per chip (activeScale 0.93)
optional withTiming on the active chip background color when selection changes

componentPlan.name: HeroCarousel
componentPlan.responsibility: Horizontal snap pager for one section's items (replaces SectionCarousel + CoverflowCard). Card width = 84% screen (Math.round(width*0.84)); neighbours peek via symmetric side padding (width-cardWidth)/2; snap = cardWidth + gap. Drives per-card coverflow interpolation and feeds PaginationDots. Renders HeroCard per item; preserves single-item centering and the presentations special card. Owns the section title.
componentPlan.props: import type { DashboardSection, DashboardItem } from '@/api/types'; interface HeroCarouselProps { section: DashboardSection; onPressItem: (item: DashboardItem) => void }
animations: scrollX = useSharedValue(0) via useAnimatedScrollHandler on the horizontal Animated.ScrollView/FlatList (UI thread)
per-card useAnimatedStyle interpolating scrollX over [(i-1)*snap, i*snap, (i+1)*snap]: scale [0.92,1,0.92], opacity [~0.6,1,~0.6], translateX [+offset,0,-offset] with Extrapolation.CLAMP
page index synced on onMomentumScrollEnd (JS thread) to drive PaginationDots

componentPlan.name: HeroCard
componentPlan.responsibility: Premium edge-to-edge hero card: expo-image cover fill with transition, expo-linear-gradient bottom scrim for legibility, radius 24-28, soft elevation, glass bottom overlay. Left = title + subtitle/progress (submitted_forms/total_forms via reused cardState()); right = status pill. Image-less fallback uses pastelAt(index) bg + accent text. cardState() logic reused verbatim.
componentPlan.props: import type { DashboardItem } from '@/api/types'; import type { Pastel } from '@/constants/theme'; interface HeroCardProps { item: DashboardItem; pastel: Pastel; onPress: () => void }
animations: no coverflow transform here; the scale/opacity/translate is applied by the parent HeroCarousel wrapper to keep HeroCard presentational

componentPlan.name: PaginationDots
componentPlan.responsibility: Theme-colored paging indicator. Active dot is wider + BRAND with an animated width; inactive dots use the border color. Centered row beneath the carousel, driven by HeroCarousel's active page (or scrollX).
componentPlan.props: interface PaginationDotsProps { count: number; activeIndex: number; style?: StyleProp<ViewStyle> }  // optional SharedValue<number> overload for fully-UI-thread continuous width morph
animations: each dot width animates via useAnimatedStyle + withTiming/withSpring on active-index change (active ~18px, inactive ~7px)
optional: interpolate dot width directly from the carousel scrollX SharedValue for a continuous morph

tokenMap.heroOverlaySubtitleText: colors.text.inverse (with style opacity, not a color literal)
tokenMap.heroImageScrim: expo-linear-gradient rgba(0,0,0,a) — allowed legibility-scrim exception only

preserveContract: onRefresh refetch + RefreshControl (refreshing state, BRAND tint)
HIDDEN_SECTIONS = new Set(['rewards','careers']) filtering of tabs and sections
Active-tab filtering ('all' shows all; otherwise s.key === activeTab)
Section ordering by meta.tabs (excluding 'all') with Object.values(sections) fallback
Social section special-casing (section.key === 'social' brand-icon linkable rows)
Presentations special card (section.key === 'presentations') and single-item centering
cardState() label/done/subline logic (status, submitted_forms/total_forms, viewed, default View)
openCard routing: external -> WebBrowser.openBrowserAsync; item.detail -> router.push('/(protected)/content/[id]', {same params}); fallback internal link -> WebBrowser
Loading skeleton (Skeleton/SkeletonCard), error empty-state + Retry, and no-results state
Auto-hiding floating tab bar scroll behavior (scrollHandler, chipReveal, settle-to-0/1 on release) stays in the screen, with CategoryTabs rendered inside it
api/types.ts models (DashboardItem, DashboardSection, DashboardTab, DashboardContentResponse, etc.) remain unchanged
notes: All five components live under components/dashboard/ with a local index.ts barrel re-exported from components/index.ts (HeroCard and PaginationDots are internal to HeroCarousel; the screen imports DashboardHeader, CategoryTabs, HeroCarousel). Colors are mapped exclusively via useTheme() per the tokenMap; the ONLY allowed color literal is BRAND (prefer colors.brand.primary, or import BRAND_GREEN as BRAND from @/constants/theme). The current screen hardcodes many literals (#13A07C, #FFFFFF, #1B2233, #9FB0C7, #6B7280, #16233A, #F2F4F8, #33425C, #D5DBE3, #0F1A2C, rgba overlays) — all must be replaced. The single permitted exception is the expo-linear-gradient image scrim using rgba(0,0,0,a) purely for legibility. Confirmed available: react-native-reanimated ~4.1.1 (with react-native-worklets 0.5.1), expo-image ~3.0.11, expo-linear-gradient ~15.0.8. Card width changes from current 0.78 to the spec's 0.84 of screen width; inactive coverflow scale relaxes from 0.86 to 0.92 per the brief. ThemeProvider is currently pinned to light (isDark always false) but components must still branch on isDark, never a literal. cardState(), greetingForNow(), HIDDEN_SECTIONS and socialIconFor() move alongside their owning components with identical logic. This is an analysis-only deliverable; no source files were modified.
